lead.headline: Tuten misses Thursday too; down 41.8 before your first snap
lead.deck: Two straight DNPs for Tuten and two limited days for Likely. Diggs is back, so he — not Etienne — covers Tuten on Sunday.
lead.body: Bad news first. Bhayshul Tuten did not practise Thursday, the only active Jaguar who sat out, after missing Wednesday too. Isaiah Likely was limited for a second day with the groin. Footballers already lead 41.8 to 0: Caleb Williams threw for 345 yards in Chicago's 38-35 win at Detroit and Christian Watson scored before his concussion. One thing improved: Stefon Diggs came off Washington's report on Thursday. So the Sunday 10:30 plan changes — if Tuten sits, Ollie Gordon II moves to RB and Diggs takes FLEX; if Likely sits, add T.J. Hockenson and drop Travis Etienne Jr. Josh Allen plays Kansas City tonight in steady rain. ESPN gives you 43%.

players.caption: Off the report — now Tuten's fallback.

doFirst.empty: Nothing to move this afternoon: the lineup is the projection lineup and Allen plays tonight.
